detailed_description:
The target video is a living two-color risograph print in <Subject 1>: every shape keeps its orange and blue ink grain, hatching and slight misregistration as it moves, like animated screen-printed frames.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The truck rolls slowly forward, its speakers shaking, the flags snapping and the flares spraying sparks. The camera rises up from the road at a steady speed in one continuous move, the truck sliding down and becoming small below as the whole march opens up along the road, thousands of raised fists and plain flags rising into silhouette against a giant burst of light growing on the horizon. The camera is still rising as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
A huge dancehall bassline from the truck's speakers, the crowd roaring and chanting, an air horn blast as the light bursts on the horizon.
